title: Kane & Abel
author: Jeffrey Archer
summary: Two men are born on the same day in 1906: Wladek, a penniless Polish immigrant who rises in America, and William Kane, a Boston banker's son. Their lives follow separate paths while a bitter feud grows between them across decades.
readIf: you like long, plot-driven sagas about ambition, money and rivalry across a lifetime.
skipIf: you want subtle prose and psychological depth over a straightforward, dramatic storyline.
